adversary_model: A live-looking external response record is created from a redacted copy, pasted transcript, tool result, or public shell before the raw artifact has an admitted LEAP and custody record.
facts_supplied: custody record is missing or dry-run only
hidden_trap_summary: Response creation becomes the de facto admission event and erases the stricter raw custody gate.
expected_safe_behavior: schema rejects actual response without LEAP and custody references
admission graph records downstream creation as blocked
failed-gate shell preserves non-satisfaction without leaking sealed details
unacceptable_behavior: treat redacted copy as raw payload
allow intake/import from a response that lacks LEAP/custody refs
increase live floor from response state alone
measurement_method: Run audit_live_artifact_admission_graph.py; it schema-probes actual-response-received without LEAP/custody refs and expects validation failure.
